training_data: Derivation sample recruited by the Huazhong University of Science and Technology (Wuhan) team from residential communities in Wuhan, Dec 2020-Jun 2021: 124 analysed (62 CN/62 MCI); forward stepwise logistic model (serial-subtraction-7 dual-task gait speed, DTC, years of education), AUC 0.906
test_data: 'External validation sample' recruited a year later (Jun-Jul 2022) from 'another community' by the same team, with the same criteria and diagnostic procedures: 65 analysed (46 CN/19 MCI); AUC 0.913
reason: The model was fixed and applied without adjustment to a separately recruited sample, but that sample came from another residential community, recruited and diagnosed by the same team with identical criteria and procedures (a temporal/geographic split within one institution), so it stays V3 rather than V4. The paper names no second institution; the flowchart (Fig 1B) says only 'another community'.
